first.rationale: Current data shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. While competitor pricing pressure exists, our primary objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, not short-term price competition. Memory_91 (activation_messaging) directly addresses the activation decline and memory_86 (onboarding simplification) addresses completion decline. Both interventions improve early-stage funnel health which is foundational to downstream revenue quality. We are verifying memory_86 and memory_91 to confirm effect sizes and transferability before committing. Promotional pricing (memory_73) would compete on the wrong dimension (price vs. value), and referral incentives (memory_57) target an already-engaged segment when our problem is activation leakage. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is valuable but doesn't address the QoQ activation/completion declines affecting our SMB base. Activation_messaging offers the most direct lever for the immediate problem while preserving our margin structure and customer quality. Standard experiment scale allows learning without over-commitment.
